extraction_notes: Direct HTTP from python returns 403 from okc.gov; PDF (29,467,030 bytes, PDF-1.7, 449 pages) fetched in-browser with credentials and streamed out as 614 base64 chunks to data_lake/gold/okc_fy27_b64.jsonl, decoded byte-exact to %TEMP%/okc_fy27_budget.pdf, parsed with PyMuPDF 1.28.2. Book cover label: FY2026-2027 Adopted Budget. Fiscal year = FY27 (July 1 2026 - June 30 2027). All FY27 'Adopted' column figures. Raw capture: %TEMP%/okc_dept_totals_raw.json.
caveats: General Fund narrative ($639M) vs table ($638,945,486) differ trivially; tabular figure used
